issues.description: The UML and problem description specify Farm::animals as a private aggregation with getter/setter, but the solution implementation declares the animals field as public. This contradicts the encapsulation indicated in the specification and may confuse students about the intended visibility and use of the animals list.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the animals field in the solution to be private (private List<Animal> animals;) and ensure public getter and setter methods are provided, matching the UML and problem statement. Update any direct references to animals in the solution to use the getter/setter or internal access consistent with encapsulation.
